stage.name: County Hillock Countryside
stage.description:
After accepting a commission from Victoria, Rhodes Island sets out to deal with Spectre Force active in the County Hillock countryside.
<Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Tattered Pillar> Can be knocked down by neighboring Operators, dealing True damage to the two tiles it falls on and forming rubble that blocks routes.

dublinn_sniffer_hound_pro.name: Dublinn Sniffer Hound Pro
dublinn_sniffer_hound_pro.flavourText: An organism controlled by the Dublinn forces, they are stronger in combat than the average Hound. They were originally purchased from a mercenary group, and have undergone training for a longer period. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

dublinn_scout_leader.name: Dublinn Scout Leader
dublinn_scout_leader.flavourText: A scout leader in the Dublinn forces. The scouts under their command are the cornerstone of the Dublinn forces' guerilla maneuvers. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

dublinn_scout.name: Dublinn Scout
dublinn_scout.flavourText: A scout for the Dublinn forces. With superb concealment techniques, they are the cornerstone of the Dublinn forces' guerilla maneuvers. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

dublinn_sniper.name: Dublinn Sniper
dublinn_sniper.flavourText: A sniper in the Dublinn forces. The crossbows they wield bear the signs of Columbian modification. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

dublinn_phalanx_infantry.name: Dublinn Phalanx Infantry
dublinn_phalanx_infantry.flavourText: A phalanx infantry in the Dublinn forces. The phalanx tactics they utilize evolved from the combat formations used in Gaul. In the phalanx, nearby infantry will support one another, increasing the might of the formation.
abilities: When other Phalanx Infantry are nearby, DEF increases (stacks)

dublinn_sniper_leader.name: Dublinn Sniper Leader
dublinn_sniper_leader.flavourText: A sniper leader in the Dublinn forces. The crossbows they wield bear the signs of Columbian modification and have much greater penetration power. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

dublinn_sniffer_hound.name: Dublinn Sniffer Hound
dublinn_sniffer_hound.flavourText: An organism controlled by the Dublinn forces. They were originally purchased from a mercenary group. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

dublinn_flying_squad_leader.name: Dublinn Flying Squad Leader
dublinn_flying_squad_leader.flavourText: A flying squad leader in the Dublinn forces. The steam propulsion device they use originates from a secret laboratory owned by the Victorian military and has gone through many iterations. Its power output is relatively stable.

dublinn_flying_soldier.name: Dublinn Flying Soldier
dublinn_flying_soldier.flavourText: A flying soldier in the Dublinn forces. The steam propulsion device they use originates from a secret laboratory owned by the Victorian military. As it has only recently been deployed in battle, its power output is still unstable.

dublinn_phalanx_commander.name: Dublinn Phalanx Commander
dublinn_phalanx_commander.flavourText: A phalanx commander in the Dublinn forces, they organize the infantry under their command into phalanx formations. The phalanx tactics they utilize evolved from the combat formations used in Gaul. In the phalanx, nearby infantry will support one another, increasing the might of the formation.
abilities: When other Phalanx Commanders are nearby, DEF increases (stacks)

dublinn_companion_guard.name: Dublinn Companion Guard
dublinn_companion_guard.flavourText: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad. The structure of this squad mimics the military system of ancient Minos. The shields they wield are the culmination of many nations' technologies, providing cover for their partners while advancing, and protecting all nearby allies from harm.
abilities: More likely to get attacked by your units
When a <Dublinn Companion Shadowblade> is nearby, activates a field that reduces nearby allied units' ASPD

dublinn_companion_shadowblade.name: Dublinn Companion Shadowblade
dublinn_companion_shadowblade.flavourText: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad. The structure of this squad mimics the military system of ancient Minos. When they move alongside their partners, they gain powerful stealth capabilities and their attacks are much swifter.
abilities: When a <Dublinn Companion Guard> is nearby, significantly increases ASPD

dublinn_heavy_defender.name: Dublinn Heavy Defender
dublinn_heavy_defender.flavourText: A heavy defender in the Dublinn forces. The armor technology they use comes from Victoria, while their boots were designed in Leithanien. Their shields look extremely similar to a newly patented product from Kazimierz's Roar Guards Company.

dublinn_heavy_defender_leader.name: Dublinn Heavy Defender Leader
dublinn_heavy_defender_leader.flavourText: A heavy defender leader in the Dublinn forces, they wield much more sophisticated equipment. The armor technology they use comes from Victoria, while their boots were designed in Leithanien. Their shields look extremely similar to a newly patented product from Kazimierz's Roar Guards Company.

dublinn_evocator.name: Dublinn Evocator
dublinn_evocator.flavourText: An evocation caster in the Dublinn forces who can control fireballs. Their leader's teachings reverberate in their minds as they work to purify the corruption of Terra in raging flames.
abilities: Controls <Purifying Flames> that move along the ground and explode after hitting a melee ally unit, dealing Arts damage and Burn; damage dealt decreases with distance moved

dublinn_flamerazer.name: Dublinn Flamerazer
dublinn_flamerazer.flavourText: A special squad that uses flamethrowers in the Dublinn forces. Their leader's teachings reverberate in their minds as they seek to reforge Terra amidst the endless flames.
abilities: Continuously deals Arts damage and Burn for the skill duration
Upon death, explodes and deals Arts damage, knocking down nearby Tattered Pillars and instantly defeating other <Dublinn Flamerazers>

mandragora.name: Mandragora
mandragora.flavourText: One of the leaders of the Dublinn forces, a caster who controls stone. Emerging from the darkness of Victoria, she has sworn to repay the humiliation she suffered at the hands of the nobles manyfold.
abilities: [Stoneshield] Reduces damage taken; temporarily loses effect after being hit by a Tattered Pillar
[Mandragora's Gaze] Targets the unit with the highest ATK within range, dealing Arts damage and reducing their ASPD. If the target is retreated or defeated, destroy the tile the unit is on
[Stoneshield] Grants Low-Altitude Hovering, and continuously deals Arts damage to units within range
